source.document: BMW Commissioning of the Sensors for the Driver Assistance Systems (Service Pack 2021, dated 6/25/2024)
source.note: BMW calls the procedure 'commissioning'. Equipment varies by vehicle option code (SA5xx series); verify equipment before calibrating.

general_requirements: Several sensors require commissioning after specific body repairs near the sensor, even when the sensor itself has not been removed.

components.location: Front of vehicle, behind the front bumper
triggers: Sensor is removed, installed, or swapped
Body repairs in the area of the radar sensor (e.g., replacing the radome or holder)
Fault 'Misalignment' is stored after repair work

components.component: Rear Radar Sensor - Blind Spot (HRSNL / HRSNR)
components.location: Rear bumper area, left and right
components.calibration_note: Comply with the regulations for repainting — paint over the sensor affects emissions.
triggers: Sensor is removed, installed, or swapped
Body repairs in the area of the sensor (e.g., replacing the bumper or holder)

components.location: Front corners, behind the front bumper near each headlight
components.calibration_note: Comply with the regulations for repainting — paint over the sensor affects emissions.
triggers: Sensor is removed, installed, or swapped
Body repairs in the area of the sensor (e.g., bumper disassembly)

components.component: Side Radar - Center Close Range (SRSNML / SRSNMR)
triggers: Fault 'Changed installation position detected' is stored
Fault 'Misalignment' is stored after repair work

components.component: KAFAS Front Camera (Camera-based Driver Assistance Module)

components.location: Windshield area (signal path connects to the HU-H radio)

not_requiring_commissioning: Front, Rear, Left, and Right Autonomous Parking Cameras (connected to UCAP)
Gesture Recognition Camera (integrated into FZD Roof Function Center)
Interior Camera (integrated into FZD Roof Function Center)
Driver Camera System (integrated into Display Cluster)
Ultrasonic Sensors (front, side front, rear, side rear — connected to UCAP/USS)
